Text/number/date: a value; single select: the option label; multiple select: a list of labels; contact, user or object fields: a list of {"id": "..."}. null or [] clears a field. Get field names from List Group Custom Fields. Groups used here are added to the record automatically.
actions.update_person_ai.props.emails.de: Email addresses (max 20); the first is primary. Replaces the whole current list, so include existing values you want to keep. Empty keeps the current list; use Clear Fields to empty it.
Full name. Use instead of first and last name when you only have one name string.
IDs of groups (grp_...) to put the person in. Get them from List Groups. Replaces all current groups, so include the ones to keep. Empty keeps the current groups; to remove all, pick groups in Clear Fields. Leaving a group also deletes its custom field values.
ID of the person to update (per_...).
actions.update_person_ai.props.phones.de: Phone numbers (max 20); the first is primary. Replaces the whole current list, so include existing values you want to keep. Empty keeps the current list; use Clear Fields to empty it.
actions.update_person_ai.props.urls.desc: Website or profile URLs (max 20). Replaces the whole current list, so include existing values you want to keep. Empty keeps the current list; use Clear Fields to empty it.
